verdict.rationale: Canny's JS SDK identifies users so feedback is tied to their existing user account, and feedback is captured directly from customers on the Portal or via integrations like Gong/Intercom/Slack, effectively linking feedback items to submitting customers. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the linkage in the PM-facing UI, and detail on how anonymized or multi-source feedback is merged to a single customer profile.
